converter.title: Convert.
converter.description: Convert DJI RJPEGs to FLIR RJPEGs

parameterPicker.useLRFDescription: If active, the distance the DJI drone measured using its Laser Range Finder will be set as the thermography's distance parameter
parameterPicker.selectFilesTip: each selected file will be converted
parameterPicker.selectFolderTip: all files in the selected folder will be converted
parameterPicker.suffixDescription: The suffix will be appended to the file name of each converted image
parameterPicker.invalidSuffix: The suffix cannot contain control characters or any of < > : " / \ | ? * or end with a space or period
